channel.title: CarExpert Pty Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CarExpert Pty Ltd (carexpert.com.au)

item.title: Ford Ranger, Toyota HiLux, Holden Caprice among vehicles stolen by thieves on bail
item.description: Victoria Police has uncovered a car theft ring using the same method seen in a recent spate of Toyota thefts, with four people charged and 21 vehicles recovered.

item.title: Toyota LandCruiser 300 Series recalled due to fire risk
item.description: More than 11,000 Toyota LandCruisers have been recalled due to a potential transmission issue which could spark a fire.

item.title: Ford Puma recalled
item.description: Over two years after issuing a recall for a particular defect in its Puma, Ford Australia is again recalling the light SUV for the same issue.

item.title: Lamborghini ditches its first EV for new plug-in hybrid GT
item.description: Lamborghini’s new, fourth model – set to be called Lanzador – won’t be an EV as the company switches to plug-in hybrid tech instead.

item.title: 2026 Skoda Kodiaq mild-hybrid priced as brand's cheapest large SUV in years
item.description: The Skoda Kodiaq's entry price has dropped with the introduction of a less powerful but more economical mild-hybrid base model.

item.title: Lexus LX recalled due to fire risk
item.description: A fault with the Lexus LX's 10-speed automatic transmission could potentially cause power loss or spark a vehicle fire.

item.title: 2026 Hyundai Elexio: New base model priced for Australia
item.description: Hyundai's new China-sourced Model Y-fighter will add a cheaper entry grade within a couple of months, dropping the entry price by $3000.

item.title: Hyundai won't revive long-running sedan nameplate in Australia
item.description: Remember the Hyundai Grandeur? The premium-leaning sedan lives on overseas with available hybrid power, but don't expect it here anytime soon.

item.title: Hyundai's first ute for Australia "still a work in progress"
item.description: There's another Korean dual-cab ute on the way, but Hyundai's local team says it's taking its time to ensure it's "the right ute, not just any ute".

item.title: Chery tuning new Ford Ranger PHEV, BYD Shark 6 rival in Australia
item.description: The Chinese automaker will develop its new dual-cab ute locally, with local expertise potentially setting the template for global versions.
